releaseNotes:
Declare remaining implicitly-declared functions (Android NDK build)

The Android buildbot (NDK r27, clang 18, default -std=gnu17 where
implicit function declarations are hard errors) fails in libretro.c:

  libretro.c:276,1869: unmountDiskOverlay
  libretro.c:1765:     writeDiskOverlay
  libretro.c:1916:     slotManagerResetCheat
  libretro.c:1942,1952: slotManagerAddCheat

A tree-wide sweep replicating the NDK's semantics (clang 18 with
-std=gnu17 appended after the Makefile's flags, so it survives the
desktop build's -std=gnu89 and -w which had been masking these as
suppressed warnings) finds the same problem at call sites the Android
build had not yet reached: unmountDiskOverlay in
Src/Emulator/Actions.c, mount/unmountDiskOverlay in
Src/Emulator/LaunchFile.c, and a second romMapperSC3000MultiCartCreate
call in Src/Board/Machine.c.

Root causes and fixes:

- The drive-level overlay API (mountDiskOverlay, writeDiskOverlay,
  unmountDiskOverlay) is implemented in Disk.c but was declared in no
  header at all; every caller in the tree relied on implicit
  declarations.  Declare it in Disk.h, which all callers already
  include.

- slotManagerAddCheat/slotManagerResetCheat are declared in
  SlotManager.h, which libretro.c never included.  Include it.

- Machine.c's ROM_SC3000_MULTICART/MEGACART cases call
  romMapperSC3000MultiCartCreate; give Machine.c the same include
  MegaromCartridge.c received in 9274f39.

With this the corrected sweep reports zero implicit declarations in
the whole tree, the clang build completes, and the determinism test
battery (including both savestate round-trips) still passes.
